role: I write a weekly newsletter about sustainable living
intent: I want to grow my newsletter to 10,000 subscribers in 6 months

nodes.title: Choose newsletter platform
nodes.description: Select the email newsletter platform before setup work begins.
nodes.prompt_template: Human approval gate: review the inputs, verify each acceptance criterion, and explicitly approve before successor nodes proceed.
acceptance_criteria: User explicitly selects the newsletter platform to use.
assumptions: Substack or Beehiiv can support the first six months.

nodes.title: Set up newsletter account
nodes.description: Configure the selected platform profile, signup page, welcome email, and basic analytics.
nodes.prompt_template: For fixture nontechnical-newsletter, complete node `setup_newsletter_account`: Configure the selected platform profile, signup page, welcome email, and basic analytics. Return the outputs and verify each acceptance criterion.
acceptance_criteria: Newsletter name and description are set.
assumptions: No paid engineering work is needed for initial setup.
unknowns: Brand assets may still need to be gathered.

nodes.title: Define audience and subscription promise
nodes.description: Clarify the target reader, newsletter promise, content pillars, and reasons to subscribe.
nodes.prompt_template: For fixture nontechnical-newsletter, complete node `define_audience_and_offer`: Clarify the target reader, newsletter promise, content pillars, and reasons to subscribe. Return the outputs and verify each acceptance criterion.
assumptions: Sustainable living tips are the core differentiator.

nodes.title: Build promotion channels
nodes.description: Create a six-month promotion plan across social, communities, referrals, and collaborations.
nodes.prompt_template: For fixture nontechnical-newsletter, complete node `build_growth_channels`: Create a six-month promotion plan across social, communities, referrals, and collaborations. Return the outputs and verify each acceptance criterion.
acceptance_criteria: At least three promotion channels are selected.
Referral or collaboration tactic is included.
assumptions: The creator can post on LinkedIn and Instagram weekly.
unknowns: Community rules for promotion may vary.

nodes.title: Write first newsletter issue
nodes.description: Draft the first issue and subject line to validate the positioning.
nodes.prompt_template: For fixture nontechnical-newsletter, complete node `write_issue_one`: Draft the first issue and subject line to validate the positioning. Return the outputs and verify each acceptance criterion.
assumptions: The creator has at least one topic ready.
unknowns: Final brand voice may need refinement.

nodes.title: Approve first email send
nodes.description: Human gate before sending the first issue to subscribers.
nodes.prompt_template: Human approval gate: review the inputs, verify each acceptance criterion, and explicitly approve before successor nodes proceed.
acceptance_criteria: Sender confirms list, subject, and content one final time before sending.
assumptions: The send cannot be silently delegated.
unknowns: Final send time is not set.

nodes.title: Establish weekly publishing rhythm
nodes.description: Track cadence, subscriber growth, and iteration after launch.
nodes.prompt_template: For fixture nontechnical-newsletter, complete node `establish_weekly_rhythm`: Track cadence, subscriber growth, and iteration after launch. Return the outputs and verify each acceptance criterion.
acceptance_criteria: Three consecutive weekly issues are scheduled or sent.
Subscriber count and conversion rate are tracked weekly.

assumptions: The creator can publish weekly and promote through existing social channels.
unknowns: Newsletter platform is not yet chosen.
Current subscriber baseline is not confirmed.
blind_spots: unknown: newsletter platform is not yet selected
assumption: the creator is writing and promoting solo
risk: subscriber growth depends on consistent cross-promotion
gate: first public send requires explicit human approval
open_questions: What is the current subscriber count?
Which platform will the creator choose?

handoff.instructions: Start at `choose_platform` and follow edges in genome.json. Do not assume answers for listed unknowns; stop at human gates for approval.
